row.evidence: ConnectWise sells PSA (Basic, Standard, Premium) and its other products by custom quote only, and its product documentation and developer docs sit behind a ConnectWise login, so whether SCIM is offered cannot be verified publicly.
row.notes: Quote-only: every ConnectWise product (PSA, Automate, RMM, CPQ, ScreenConnect and others) is priced by request-a-quote forms; PSA has Basic, Standard and Premium editions with no public prices. Researched the main admin product (ConnectWise PSA, formerly Manage). The public Secure by Design page commits to SSO and MFA across all platforms and says ConnectWise will never charge for SSO or MFA, but no SSO or SCIM setup guide is public: docs.connectwise.com and the developer network (PSA REST API) redirect to the ConnectWise sign-in page. Okta's ConnectWise and ConnectWise Automate OIN apps are password-vaulting (SWA) only (read from page markup). No ConnectWise entry in the Microsoft Learn SaaS tutorial index. Status unknown, confidence low.

scim.notes: No public SCIM documentation; product docs require a ConnectWise login.

user_api.notes: ConnectWise PSA and Automate have developer APIs, but the developer network shows content only after login, so user-management endpoints could not be checked.

okta.notes: OIN 'ConnectWise' (PSA, last updated Mar 2016) and 'ConnectWise Automate' (Feb 2020) apps have only SWA checked; 'ConnectWise Custom Portal' is also SWA only. No SCIM capability on any of them (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No ConnectWise tutorial in the Microsoft Learn SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com returned HTTP 403 to scripted requests.

fallbacks.notes: SSO is promised across all platforms at no charge (Secure by Design page), but how users are created is not public.
